from common import *
import gc,gzip
def main():
 save_source(__file__);harness('check')
 import numpy as np,pandas as pd,qlib
 from backtest.scripts.train.train_regime_arm import frame_signature
 qlib.init(provider_uri=str(PROVIDER),region='cn',kernels=1)
 from qlib.data import D
 assert str(pd.Timestamp(D.calendar(start_time='2020-01-01')[-1]).date())=='2026-11-03'
 with gzip.open(PREVIOUS/'docs/provider-inputs.json.gz','rt') as f:inventory=json.load(f)
 for r in inventory['files']:check(r)
 dates=pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(pd.read_csv(DATES,comment='#')['date']))
 oldprep=read(PRIOR/'docs/prepared-labels.json');study=read(BASE/'configs/frozen-study.json')
 affine=study['label_processing']['affine'];scale,offset=affine['scale'],affine['offset']
 prepared={'variants':{},'expectations':{},'controls':{},'provider_inventory':fingerprint(PREVIOUS/'docs/provider-inputs.json.gz'),'provider_files_verified':len(inventory['files']),'label_definition':study['label_processing']}
 def encode(s):
  groups=grade(s,'quantile10');y=(groups.astype(float)*scale+offset).astype(np.float32);y.name='LABEL0'
  assert np.isfinite(y.to_numpy()).all() and groups.between(0,9).all()
  return y,{'bin_counts':[int((groups==i).sum()) for i in range(10)],'mean':float(y.mean()),'std':float(y.astype(float).std(ddof=0)),'scale':scale,'offset':offset}
 for h in [7,15]:
  pieces=[]
  for b in oldprep['horizons'][str(h)]['blocks']:
   check(b);s=pd.read_pickle(ROOT/b['path']);pieces.append(s.loc[s.index.get_level_values('datetime').isin(dates)].dropna())
  s=pd.concat(pieces);assert s.index.is_unique
  expected=read(PRIOR/'docs'/f'inputs-h{h}.json')
  assert frame_signature(s)['index_sha256']==expected['training']['index_sha256']
  assert len(s)==oldprep['horizons'][str(h)]['training_rows']
  y,stats=encode(s);variant=f'h{h}q10';p=BASE/'data'/f'{variant}.pkl';y.to_pickle(p)
  prepared['variants'][variant]={'new':fingerprint(p),'horizon':h,'label_signature':frame_signature(y),'stats':stats,'paired_continuous_inputs':fingerprint(PRIOR/'docs'/f'inputs-h{h}.json')}
  prepared['expectations'][variant]={'index_sha256':expected['training']['index_sha256'],'feature_array_sha256':expected['feature_array_sha256'],'rows':len(y)}
  prepared['controls'][f'h{h}continuous']={'metrics':fingerprint(PRIOR/'metrics'/f'h{h}-model.json'),'models':fingerprint(PRIOR/'docs'/f'sources-h{h}.json')}
  print('prepared',variant,len(y),flush=True);del s,y,pieces;gc.collect()
 fields=[f'Ref($close,-{k+1})/Ref($close,-1)-1' for k in range(1,21)]
 sum_parts=[];raw_parts=[];year_audits=[]
 for b in oldprep['horizons']['20']['blocks']:
  year=b['year'];reference=pd.read_pickle(ROOT/b['path'])
  raw=D.features(D.instruments('all'),fields,start_time=f'{year}-01-01',end_time=min(f'{year}-12-31','2020-07-31'))
  raw.index=raw.index.set_names(['instrument','datetime']);raw=raw.swaplevel().sort_index().reindex(reference.index)
  terminal=raw.iloc[:,-1];rank=(terminal.groupby(level='datetime').rank(pct=True)-.5)*3.46
  assert np.array_equal(rank.to_numpy(dtype=np.float32),reference.to_numpy(dtype=np.float32),equal_nan=True),('H20 raw control reproduction failed',year)
  valid=np.isfinite(raw.to_numpy()).all(axis=1);s=pd.Series(raw.to_numpy(dtype=np.float64).sum(axis=1),index=raw.index,name='path_sum').where(valid)
  ranked=(s.groupby(level='datetime').rank(pct=True)-.5)*3.46
  keep=ranked.index.get_level_values('datetime').isin(dates)&valid
  y=ranked.loc[keep];y.name='LABEL0';sum_parts.append(y)
  # Same t+1 entry; 20 daily price changes implied by the 20 cumulative returns.
  wealth=np.column_stack([np.ones(int(valid.sum())),1+raw.to_numpy(dtype=np.float64)[valid]])
  daily=wealth[:,1:]/wealth[:,:-1]-1
  vol=pd.Series(np.std(daily,axis=1,ddof=1),index=raw.index[valid],name='path_volatility')
  raw_parts.append(pd.DataFrame({'path_sum':s.loc[keep],'terminal_h20':terminal.loc[keep],'path_volatility':vol.reindex(y.index)}))
  train_sel=reference.index.get_level_values('datetime').isin(dates)
  year_audits.append({'year':year,'h20_rows':int((train_sel&reference.notna()).sum()),'sum_rows':len(y),'additional_missing_due_to_intermediate_prices':int((train_sel&reference.notna()&~valid).sum()),'raw_h20_float32_rank_reproduced':True})
  print('prepared sum year',year,'rows',len(y),'lost',year_audits[-1]['additional_missing_due_to_intermediate_prices'],flush=True)
  del raw,reference,s,rank,ranked,y,wealth,daily,vol;gc.collect()
 continuous=pd.concat(sum_parts);rawdata=pd.concat(raw_parts);del sum_parts,raw_parts;gc.collect()
 assert continuous.index.equals(rawdata.index) and continuous.index.is_unique and np.isfinite(continuous.to_numpy()).all()
 assert np.isfinite(rawdata.to_numpy()).all()
 for variant,s in [('sum20continuous',continuous),('sum20q10',encode(continuous)[0])]:
  p=BASE/'data'/f'{variant}.pkl';s.to_pickle(p);prepared['variants'][variant]={'new':fingerprint(p),'horizon':20,'label_signature':frame_signature(s),'training_rows':len(s),'quantization':encode(continuous)[1] if variant.endswith('q10') else None}
 rawp=BASE/'data/path-sum-training-diagnostics.pkl';rawdata.to_pickle(rawp)
 # Compute exact feature hashes for the sum mask in original annual row/column order.
 fm=read(FEATURE);sha=hashlib.sha256()
 for year in range(2004,2021):
  block=fm['blocks'][str(year)];p=FEATURE.parent/block['path'];check({**block,'path':str(p)})
  f=pd.read_pickle(p);ix=continuous.index[continuous.index.get_level_values('datetime').year==year];assert ix.isin(f.index).all()
  a=f.reindex(ix).to_numpy()
  for i in range(0,len(a),8192):sha.update(a[i:i+8192].tobytes(order='C'))
  del f,a;gc.collect()
 expected=read(PRIOR/'docs/inputs-h20.json')
 assert frame_signature(continuous)['index_sha256']==expected['training']['index_sha256'] and sha.hexdigest()==expected['feature_array_sha256'],'Sum target has a changed training mask; inspect before allowing fits'
 for v in ['sum20continuous','sum20q10']:prepared['expectations'][v]={'index_sha256':frame_signature(continuous)['index_sha256'],'feature_array_sha256':sha.hexdigest(),'rows':len(continuous)}
 # The raw-sum formula is not a monotone preference for low volatility.
 smooth=np.linspace(0,.10,21);volatile=np.r_[0.,np.repeat(.20,19),.10]
 assert smooth[-1]==volatile[-1] and volatile[1:].sum()>smooth[1:].sum()
 assert np.std(np.diff(volatile+1)/(volatile+1)[:-1])>np.std(np.diff(smooth+1)/(smooth+1)[:-1])
 terminal_decile=(rawdata['terminal_h20'].groupby(level='datetime').rank(pct=True)*10).apply(np.ceil).clip(1,10)
 group=[rawdata.index.get_level_values('datetime'),terminal_decile.to_numpy()]
 sr=rawdata['path_sum'].groupby(group).rank(pct=True);vr=rawdata['path_volatility'].groupby(group).rank(pct=True)
 demean=lambda x:x-x.groupby(group).transform('mean')
 diagnostic={'raw_training':fingerprint(rawp),'year_masks':year_audits,'same_mask_as_H20':True,'conditional_rank_correlation_sum_vs_vol':float(demean(sr).corr(demean(vr))),'conditional_definition':'Pearson of centered within-(date,H20-terminal-decile) percentile ranks; descriptive training-only association. Positive favors higher volatility within terminal bins.','counterexample_same_terminal_return':.10,'counterexample_smooth_sum':float(smooth[1:].sum()),'counterexample_volatile_sum':float(volatile[1:].sum()),'conclusion_scope':'Raw path sum measures area above entry price; neither the formula nor larger sum guarantees lower realized path volatility.'}
 write(BASE/'docs/label-mechanism.json',diagnostic)
 # Boundary and tie behavior from existing grading protocol.
 idx=pd.MultiIndex.from_product([pd.to_datetime(['2010-01-04']),list('abcdefghij')],names=['datetime','instrument'])
 test=pd.Series((np.arange(1,11)/10-.5)*3.46,index=idx);assert grade(test,'quantile10').tolist()==list(range(10))
 test.iloc[1:3]=(.25-.5)*3.46;assert grade(test,'quantile10').iloc[1]==grade(test,'quantile10').iloc[2]
 prepared['checks']=['Exact H20 raw-rank reproduction by all17years','Same final training mask as H20 for both sum arms','Exact H7/H15 original ordered masks','Existing fixed q10 affine; no reranking','All20 raw cumulative returns summed in float64, no skipna','Quantile boundaries/ties tested','No guarantee of lower volatility demonstrated with equal-terminal paths']
 write(BASE/'configs/prepared-inputs.json',prepared)
 state=read(PROGRESS);state.update(status='prepared',prepared_inputs=fingerprint(BASE/'configs/prepared-inputs.json'));write(PROGRESS,state)
 print('All four label targets prepared; zero fits.',flush=True)
if __name__=='__main__':main()
